One continuous scene per beat; long-VO sections split into 2-3 continuous sub-shots of the SAME scene. Gates before render: lock Bentley_TALKING_MASTER.png, lock Mira master + voice, establish meadow + grove plates. shots.keyframe: Dawn coastal bluff above Crystal Cove; the sky fills edge to edge with a river of orange monarchs pouring overhead; Bentley spins, mouth open, tail-stub wiggling, then leaps up to catch one and tumbles in the grass. Warm sunrise. On-model Bentley (mask, teal collar, gold paw tag).

seq.desc: sky-river of monarchs pours over the dawn bluff — slow upward drift (sky still)
Bentley spins & leaps up at the sky-river, tries to catch one, tumbles in the grass
push across the river of butterflies over the sea (sky still)

shots.keyframe: Title card 'THE BUTTERFLY HIGHWAY' over the orange sky-river (sub-range of s1a).

seq.desc: Title 'THE BUTTERFLY HIGHWAY' over the sky-river

shots.keyframe: CU: a single monarch (Mira) spirals down and lands on Bentley's nose, tapping/tasting it with her tiny feet; Bentley goes cross-eyed, delighted. Soft dawn light. Rhymes EP3 antenna-tap.

seq.desc: RESTAGE — 3/4 two-shot, Bentley's muzzle angled OFF-camera (not a straight nose-CU): Mira taste-taps her nose, Bentley cross-eyed & yelps
Mira flutters up & loops introducing herself; Bentley grins back (muzzle 3/4, mouth off-axis)
push on the sky-river above the two new friends

shots.keyframe: Two-shot on the bluff edge: Mira loops and swirls playfully around Bentley and zips off down the coast; Bentley bounces up to follow. Wide, both in frame, meadow + sea behind.

seq.desc: Mira loops around Bentley & zips off down the bluff; Bentley bounces up to follow
tracking-style push down the coastal bluff path Mira flew (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Bentley trotting after Mira, tilting her head, 'listing' on her paws (map? plan? snacks?) while overshooting the looping butterfly. Comedic chase motion, medium-wide, both in frame.

seq.desc: Bentley trots after the looping Mira, head-tilting on 'map? plan? snacks?', overshooting
insert push: meadow path + skidding paw-prints (scene still)
the sky-river / meadow ahead where Mira flits

shots.keyframe: Meadow two-shot: Mira lands on a bright wildflower and taste-tests it with her feet, wings fanning; Bentley leans in close, fascinated. Sunny flower field.

seq.desc: meadow two-shot: Mira lands on a wildflower & taste-tests it with her feet; Bentley leans in fascinated
macro push on the bright wildflower Mira tasted (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Bentley tries to copy Mira - steps on / licks a flower, then a big pollen puff makes her sneeze, ears flapping; Mira giggles and loops. Comedy motion, both in frame.

seq.desc: Bentley copies Mira — licks a flower, pollen puffs, BIG sneeze, ears flapping; Mira giggles & loops
insert: pollen cloud drifting off the flower (scene still)
the flower bank + drifting monarchs (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Bentley bounds ahead down a meadow path, huffing, 'leading', trying to out-run the drifting butterflies. Tracking shot, monarchs calmly floating past her. No danger.

seq.desc: Bentley bounds ahead down the meadow path 'leading', huffing; monarchs drift calmly past
tracking push down the meadow path, butterflies floating (scene still)

shots.keyframe: MATCH-CUT on the bound: Bentley face-plants into a soft bank of flowers, petals flying, dizzy and puffed out; butterflies drift serenely past. Funny, warm.

seq.desc: Bentley face-plants into the soft flower bank, petals flying, dizzy; Mira loops back amused
insert: petals settling, monarchs drifting past (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Bentley lies still in the flowers; the gold Listening Tag GLOWS; camera tilts up from her to reveal the whole gliding river of monarchs leaning sunward. Catchphrase = Bentley (locked Talking prop for the CU); then VO-over as camera reveals the sky.

seq.desc: catchphrase CU on the Talking prop: Bentley still, Tag GLOWS, 'Stop. Look. Listen.'
camera tilts/pushes UP off Bentley to reveal the whole gliding river of monarchs leaning sunward (sky still)
slow drift across the sunward river of butterflies (sky still)
the river flowing toward the sun over the meadow

shots.keyframe: Meadow two-shot: Bentley (amazed) looking up at Mira who loops cheerfully; the sky river behind them. Bentley asks where it ends.

seq.desc: meadow two-shot: Bentley (amazed) looks up at Mira looping cheerfully; the sky-river behind
the sky-river of monarchs streaming toward the sun (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Bentley's joyful mind-blown reaction (tongue out, tail-stub wiggle, spinning) as Mira loops around her; monarchs streaming past toward the sun. Both in frame, warm.

seq.desc: Bentley's joyful mind-blown reaction — spinning, tongue out, tail-stub wiggle — Mira looping around her
monarchs streaming past toward the sun over the meadow (scene still)
wide of the meadow + the river of butterflies (scene still)

shots.keyframe: THE hero shot: a warm updraft rises off the bluff; Bentley run-leaps off the edge and GLIDES (ears out, legs tucked - a glide, NOT flapping flight) down through the swirling river of monarchs, Mira looping around her, both joyful. Golden sky. The swarm carries the motion and hides seams.

seq.desc: updraft rises; Bentley run-leaps off the bluff & GLIDES into the monarch river, Mira looping at her nose
HERO/THUMBNAIL: Bentley soaring through the swirling river of monarchs over the sea, Mira beside her
the golden sky full of monarchs, the gliding pair small in it (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Wide: an old eucalyptus grove with thousands of monarchs clustered on the branches like living orange leaves; soft shafts of light. (Can be a still + slow Ken-Burns to save credit.)

seq.desc: old eucalyptus grove, thousands of monarchs clustered on the branches — slow reveal drift (grove still)

shots.keyframe: Closer: living-orange clusters gently fanning their wings; Bentley and Mira small in the foreground, awed. Warm, cozy.

seq.desc: RESTAGE — foreground two-shot: Bentley & Mira PROMINENT in the foreground, gazing up in wonder at the grove full of clustered monarchs ('Look at them ALL… Home!'), clusters fanning behind them
the living-orange clusters gently fanning on the branches (grove still)

shots.keyframe: Grove two-shot beside a green chrysalis: Bentley does a delighted double-take at Mira ('you were a WORM?'); Mira giggles. Cozy golden light.

seq.desc: grove two-shot by the green chrysalis: Bentley's delighted double-take at Mira — 'you were a WORM?'
macro push on the green chrysalis on its twig (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Warm two-shot: Bentley marvels at the chrysalis / at Mira's wings; Mira fans them; a caterpillar-to-wings wonder. Cozy, both in frame.

seq.desc: warm grove two-shot: Bentley marvels as Mira fans her wings beside the chrysalis
insert: the chrysalis + a fresh butterfly unfurling, slow push (scene still)
the grove in warm light, monarchs settling (scene still)

shots.keyframe: Night in the eucalyptus grove, cozy and warm; monarchs glow softly on the branches. Two-shot: Bentley curls down into the soft leaf-litter with a big sleepy yawn, Mira perched on a low twig beside her. Peaceful, golden lantern light. No menace.

seq.desc: night falls on the grove, monarchs glowing on the branches (scene still), slow drift
night two-shot: Bentley curls down with a big yawn, Mira on a twig beside her; sleepy reflection
the cozy moonlit grove, glowing monarchs (scene still)

shots.keyframe: A gentle night breeze moves through the tall eucalyptus; leaves shiver and the grove seems to hum/sing softly (dreamy, magical -- the EP5 talking-trees seed, NOT scary). Bentley's ears flick drowsily as she snuggles down; Mira settles. Soft moonlit glow.

seq.desc: night breeze through the tall eucalyptus; leaves shiver, the grove seems to hum/sing; Bentley snuggling, Mira settling (scene still), gentle drift

shots.keyframe: Tender CU: Bentley curled nose-to-paws, eyes drifting closed, lips barely moving as she whispers to herself; the gold paw-print Listening Tag glows soft and warm; Mira nestled on her paw. She breathes out and falls asleep. VO-over (whisper, mouth barely readable). Peaceful, emotionally warm.

seq.sync: vo-over-alive (whisper: mouth barely moving, eyes closing)
seq.desc: tender CU: Bentley curled nose-to-paws, eyes drifting closed, whispering the mantra; Tag glows soft; Mira asleep on her paw
insert: the gold Listening Tag glowing warm over the sleeping pair (scene still)
the moonlit grove, everyone asleep, monarchs glowing (scene still)
